parameters.selection: highest-scoring pairs capped at 150 for class 150; 100 otherwise
parameters.insufficient_pairs: retain all eligible pairs when fewer than the cap remain

change_note: Original supplied gremlin_jaccard.py and gremlin_jaccard_v2.py used GREMLIN_TOP_N=100. Raise the cap to 150 only for class 150; retain z-score >=1 and all other settings. Raw GREMLIN inference was not capped at 100.
